purpose: Account of building and evolving minsearch

required_facts.fact: minsearch began for LLM Zoomcamp notebook teaching.
Elasticsearch was too operationally heavy for workshops.
The first implementation was one Python file with TF-IDF.
Field boosting and keyword filtering supported FAQ examples.
The library was later published on PyPI.
AppendableIndex and VectorSearch were added later.
Highlighting was added for agent snippets.
The appendable index was initially 14x/27x slower.
Claude optimization produced 20–76x faster search in the benchmark.
The recommended sweet spot is up to 10,000 documents.
